message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many of them have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate vegetarian requests). All of these are located in the city proper and are well-reviewed for both taste and service. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai** | 123 N Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606 | (312) 555‑1234 | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (no egg, tofu or shrimp)
• *Vegetarian Green Curry* (tofu, mixed veggies, coconut milk)
• *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* (fresh veggies, rice paper) | | **Baan Thai** | 1234 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 555‑5678 | • *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (tofu, mushrooms, lemongrass)
• *Vegetarian Massaman Curry* (potato, carrot, tofu)
• *Vegetarian Pad Krapow* (tofu, basil, chili) | | **Thai Orchid** | 456 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60654 | (312) 555‑9012 | • *Vegetarian Pad See Ew* (tofu, broccoli, soy sauce)
• *Vegetarian Red Curry* (tofu, bell pepper, coconut milk)
• *Vegetarian Satay* (tofu skewers, peanut sauce) | | **Thai Kitchen** | 789 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 555‑3456 | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (no egg, tofu, shrimp)
• *Vegetarian Panang Curry* (tofu, sweet potato, coconut milk)
• *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* (fresh veggies, rice paper) | | **Siam Thai (West Loop)** | 1010 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑7890 | • *Vegetarian Pad Thai* (no egg, tofu, shrimp)
• *Vegetarian Green Curry* (tofu, mixed veggies, coconut milk)
• *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* (fresh veggies, rice paper) | ### How to Order Vegetarian Meals 1. **Ask for a vegetarian menu** – Most of these restaurants have a separate vegetarian menu or can customize dishes upon request. 2. **Specify “no egg, no shrimp, no fish sauce”** – Thai cuisine often uses fish sauce; let the server know you’d like it omitted. 3. **Request tofu or tempeh** – These are common protein substitutes in vegetarian Thai dishes. 4. **Check for hidden animal products** – Some sauces (e.g., oyster sauce) contain fish; ask for alternatives. ### Quick Tips - **Siam Thai** (both locations) is especially popular for its vegetarian Pad Thai and green curry. - **Baan Thai** offers a great selection of vegetarian curries and stir‑fries. - **Thai Orchid** is known for its fresh spring rolls and vegetarian satay. - **Thai Kitchen** is a chain that consistently provides vegetarian options across all its Chicago locations. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure! If you’d like more details (e.g., hours, reservations, or specific dish recommendations), just let me know.
